calculate_runwayml_image_cost: calculate the cost of RunwayML image generation given a model name and image response object
get_runwayml_model_pricing: get the per-image pricing for a RunwayML model from litellm model info
validate_image_response_type: validate that an image response is of type ImageResponse before calculating cost
count_generated_images: count the number of generated images from an ImageResponse data list
multiply_cost_per_image: multiply the cost per image by the number of images to get total cost
